KAREN_HAIRPIN_RELIC.title: Hairpin
KAREN_HAIRPIN_RELIC.description: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, add a [gold]Tower of Promise[/gold] to your hand.
KAREN_HAIRPIN_RELIC.flavor: One of a pair of crown-shaped hairpins Karen and Hikari bought together as children at a shop near Tokyo Tower.
KAREN_HAIRPIN2_RELIC.title: Hairpin - 3D Version
KAREN_HAIRPIN2_RELIC.description: At the start of your [blue]1st[/blue] turn, add a [gold]Tower of Promise+[/gold] to your hand.
KAREN_HAIRPIN2_RELIC.flavor: One of a pair of crown-shaped hairpins Karen and Hikari bought together as children at a shop near Tokyo Tower.
KAREN_LOCK_RELIC.title: Locked Relic
KAREN_LOCK_RELIC.description: A relic is locked here. It will unlock at the end of combat.
